_note: <<Paper title>>: word lists for scripts/check_draft.py, created <<date>>.

_help.presets: Switches for the three presets the script checks; true means enabled. Keep them the same as section 2 of project_constraints.md.
_help.proper_names_from_glossary: true (default): proper names are read from the Proper names table of the glossary. Set it to false if the script cannot read your glossary, and list the names in extra_proper_names.
_help.extra_proper_names: Proper names to check that are not in the glossary; usually empty.
_help.forbidden: Forbidden forms; a hit is a must-fix. Each entry has pattern (a regular expression), why (an English note naming the rule and the glossary ID, for example "T2 T03: write use, not utilize") and optionally ignore_case (default true). Mirrors the Forbidden forms column of the glossary.
_help.hints: Words that are only hinted; read the sentence and decide. Same format as forbidden. For words that are usually wrong here but also have legitimate uses.
_help.abbreviation_whitelist: Abbreviations that need no spelling out; the L2 check skips them.
_help.repeated_verbs: Optional key. Ordinary verbs for the L10 hint, each with label and pattern; without it the script uses use and exceed.
_help.glossary_names_heading, glossary_english: Optional keys. Fill them only when the heading and the column of the glossary are not the default Proper names and English.
